in_sanskrit.name: रामसेवक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
Rama + सेवक (sevak) 
Rama: God Rama
सेवक (sevak): servant, devotee

in_hindi.name: रामसेवक
in_hindi.long_meaning:
राम + सेवक (sevak) 
राम: गोद राम (God Rama)
सेवक (sevak): दवेशी (devotee), दास (servant)

in_tamil.name: ராமசேவக்
in_tamil.long_meaning:
ராம் + சேவக் (cēvak) 
राम்: இந்தியாவிடம் இல்லையில்லை அவர்களில் இருந்த கோழிய தொல்லை அருள்வான (God Rama)
சேவக் (cēvak): வாழ்வியர் (devotee), கோட்டையார் (servant)

in_telugu.name: రామజీవక్
in_telugu.long_meaning:
రామ్ + జీవక్ (jīvaka) 
రామ్: ఇద్దరికి ఇద్దరీకొట్టదే దేశీయ (God Rama)
జీవక్ (jīvaka): దేశియ (devotee), దేశీ (servant)

in_marathi.name: Ramsewak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Rama, servant of Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramsewak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram + sewak, the one who serves Rama

in_bengali.name: Ramsewak
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Rama, servant of Rama
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramsewak একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ram + sewak, the one who serves Rama

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ramsewak" is rooted in Hindu culture, where Rama is one of the most revered gods. The suffix "sewak" signifies a servant or devotee of God Rama.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Ramsewak" holds spiritual importance as it highlights the devotee's commitment and dedication to serve and follow the teachings of the Hindu god Rama. It underscores the belief in being selfless and giving to the divine, embodying the essence of being a true devotee.

name_in_real_life.story: Devi Ramsewak, a teacher in Bali, Indonesia, shares that their name Ramsewak meaning "God of Rama, servant of Rama" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramsewak: Servant of Lord Rama. Embodiment of devotion and selfless service.
